verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is that Ari can create several scenarios from a single one-line request, and can re-import past months after you fix them in your books. That is batch action over multiple items, but it is limited to scenario creation and sync re-imports. missing for 10: a documented general bulk-edit or batch operation across many model items (tables, formulas, variables, pages), bulk operations via MCP tools, stated limits or scale for batch actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
